description: Sharp positive-definite translational Hessian for the Beer visibility index of an eccentric disk-with-circular-hole domain.
scientific_integrity: Concentric base formula credited to Hodge, Marshall and Patterson; proof of the new Hessian is supplied analytically, with standalone numerical diagnostics.
scientific_limitations: Only two-dimensional normalized-area sampling, fixed hole radius 0<a<1 and sufficiently small hole displacement; no global-in-displacement claim and no uniform thin-shell remainder. Historical priority and independent mathematical audit remain open.
title: Eccentric-hole Hessian for the planar Beer index
